title: Detailed gift bag
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bag body -->
  <rect x="22" y="38" width="56" height="50" rx="4" fill="#FF4F81"/>
  <!-- Bag body lighter panel for depth -->
  <rect x="26" y="42" width="48" height="42" rx="2" fill="#FF7BA5"/>
  <!-- Bag body shading at bottom -->
  <rect x="22" y="76" width="56" height="12" rx="4" fill="#E63B6E"/>
  <!-- Bag body side gusset hints -->
  <rect x="22" y="38" width="5" height="50" rx="2" fill="#D92D60"/>
  <rect x="73" y="38" width="5" height="50" rx="2" fill="#D92D60"/>
  <!-- Bag top opening rim -->
  <rect x="22" y="36" width="56" height="5" rx="2" fill="#C0264F"/>
  <!-- Left handle -->
  <path d="M32 38 C32 22, 48 22, 48 38" fill="none" stroke="#FFD447" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right handle -->
  <path d="M52 38 C52 22, 68 22, 68 38" fill="none" stroke="#FFD447" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Handle highlight -->
  <path d="M33.5 38 C33.5 24, 46.5 24, 46.5 38" fill="none" stroke="#FFE98A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Ribbon bow left loop -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="60" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#FFD447" transform="rotate(-20 38 60)"/>
  <!-- Ribbon bow right loop -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="60" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#FFD447" transform="rotate(20 62 60)"/>
  <!-- Ribbon bow center knot -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="5" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <!-- Ribbon tails -->
  <path d="M46 64 L38 84 L44 80 Z" fill="#FFD447"/>
  <path d="M54 64 L62 84 L56 80 Z" fill="#FFD447"/>
  <!-- Polka dots on bag -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="50" r="3" fill="#FFE98A"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="3" fill="#FFE98A"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="50" r="3" fill="#FFE98A"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="68" r="3" fill="#FFE98A"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="68" r="3" fill="#FFE98A"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="78" r="2.5" fill="#FFE98A"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="76" r="2.5" fill="#FFE98A"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="78" r="2.5" fill="#FFE98A"/>
  <!-- Tissue paper peeking out top -->
  <path d="M28 38 L36 28 L42 36 L48 26 L54 36 L60 28 L68 38" fill="none" stroke="#7ED6FF" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M32 38 L36 30 L42 37" fill="#A8E6FF" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M56 38 L60 30 L66 37" fill="#A8E6FF" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
